rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for banned words (honest, delve, landscape-verb, importantly, crucial, substrate, leverage-verb, synergize, paradigm shift) returned zero matches in body prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Grep for ritual, ceremony returned zero matches. Word practice appears sparingly per design (not in this body). No banned forms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no "fixed" retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body contains no dated session references, no "fixed" annotations, no retrospective clauses stating transitions. Dated provenance headers exist in maintainer block (below fence), not in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body voice balances AE101 quintet (Boris: factual; Martin: strategic; Godin: peer-warm; Sutherland: insightful-reframe; Siilasmaa: optimistic-action). No consultancy pap, no defensiveness.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a finished lecture, not article rough-cut prose. Rule applies to drafting stage, not final curriculum.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 184 paraphrases Campbell's variation-selection-retention without naming Campbell in body. Maintainer block line 267 explicitly states attribution stays maintainer-side per cultural-vocabulary carve-out. This is deliberate design, not violation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always "you", never "the student"; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Second-person throughout ("You drew", "you judge", "the checks you built"). Zero instances of "the student" or author-we. No delivery mechanics in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "The three-pattern" (line 172) is bolded and was explicitly named in-room at M5. Not smuggled; deliberately emphasized per emphasis-pass note (maintainer line 204). Term is earned before use.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reassurance language found. No "no penalty", "it's OK if", "not a downgrade". Prose states principles without defensive hedging.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This lecture close states principles and laws already established in-room. No external frames cited verbatim; no reference artifact exists yet for this file. Rule inapplicable.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No practitioner names appear in body prose. Klaassen, Campbell, David, Brynjolfsson all credited in maintainer block only. Body teaches laws without practitioner attribution.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Slogans are sharp and unhedged: "Find is easier than judge" (line 171), "A rule in context is not a rule in the output" (line 183). Each followed by explanation, not softened by same-sentence carve-out.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No positioning-defense phrasing. No "not aspirational", "not vendor", "grounded in actual". Body teaches the map and loop without defending training's value proposition.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "Feedback control" earned in-breath (one-sentence intro then term). "Non-deterministic agent" describes property students have lived with for 5 modules. "Eval", "verifier", "judge", "gate", "drift", "compounding" all earned at point of use or earlier.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is M6 consolidation lecture with no exercise-forcing-function trims. Bullets end on maxims and principles, no dangling pronouns or bypass-the-agent punchlines. Rule scope inapplicable.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The **What happened:** block is OPTIONAL — default is to omit it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture, not an exercise. No **What happened:** block present or expected. Rule applies to exercise format, not applicable to lecture close.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Agent-interaction verbs stay peer-flat: "The agent finds", "you judge". No bark/order/command/whip/force/drag/push/boss/scold. Peer-warmth maintained.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "The checking loop, drawn solid" — literal (diagram shows it). "You drew a control loop" — literal (student designed across modules). "Verification, named" — literal (section names principle). No metaphorical headers contradicting mechanism.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negation, no deictic drumroll, no bold-label echo, no duplicate citation. Prose carries content weight throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 172 lists three pattern-types with no preceding numeral. Numerals in body are content (80/20 in line 179, not structural tallies). No redundant counts adjacent to lists.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All slogans test true: "Find is easier than judge" holds broadly. "A rule in context is not a rule in the output" is observable. "Dashed is a state, not a place" is precise. No false slogans disguised as bold.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a single-file evaluation (not a multi-file verification sweep). No sibling files re-stating the same claims within same training section. Rule applies across paired lecture/exercise files, not within one file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session — re-derive it per target, not per sweep.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is not a multi-file sweep evaluation. Rule scope is the protocol for sweeps in progress, not applicable to single-file cold-start evaluation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "You drew a control loop" frames student as designer. "Every move in this training has a place on this map" — aspirational (you have built something mappable). No corrective-gap framing. Professional audience positioned as equals.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "Feedback control" earned in-breath (line 164, one-sentence primer). "Verifier", "judge", "gate" taught via three-pattern definition (line 172). "Eval" earned through prior module work. No cold technical terms.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.evidence: No unearned tech words. Vocabulary is engineering-native (agent, loop, gate, check, drift, rule, encode, session). No jargon that would make SVP flinch. Complies with business-audience ban.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 185: "what compounds is the part a team takes up" uses "compounds" (memory side). No confusion between persistent artifacts (rules, memory files) and ambient runtime state. Distinction held clean.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All prose follows main narrative forward. No troubleshooting branches, no "what if X fails" scenarios, no recovery paths. Body is calm forward-moving consolidation, not pre-emptive FAQ.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture close (teaching prose), not a prompt-design context. Rule applies to prompt-specification surface, not curriculum prose.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is M6 lecture close (teaching consolidation), not an exercise Debrief. Rule applies to module-end Debrief structure, not lecture format.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Voice is consistent M6 consolidation-and-recognition throughout. No joyful-creation tone (M1), no long-running weariness tone (M5). Tone matches module position and mood design.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No instruction asks student to manually diff or spot-check. Prose describes patterns and mechanisms Claude will implement. No error-catching asks; no manual verification burden on student.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture, not a self-study simulation. No simulations present; rule applies to self-study training format, not standard lectures.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No "What research says" callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No "What research says" boxes present. Research sources live in maintainer block as backing stamps, not as student-facing callout. Complies with practitioner-voice-first approach.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture close (teaching content), no student-action moves specified. No editor/terminal commands required outside agent conversation. Lecture is read-and-learn, not do-and-chat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 183 specifies `./CLAUDE.local.md` (not bare CLAUDE.md). Layer is explicit where mentioned. No ambiguity about governance or gitignore status.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Zero em-dashes in body prose. Sentences are simple and short. Commas used instead of dashes. Prose is readable aloud and friendly to tired engineer.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Structural elements (headers appropriate to format).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture sections use declarative noun-phrase headers ("Verification, named"; "Outcome, named"). Per carve-out, lectures permit declarative headers. Compliant with format conventions.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Prose and language clarity.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Prose uses clear bullet structures, bolded law names, direct sections. Language is transparent and non-rhetorical. No manipulative emphasis or forced tone.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Lecture sections use declarative noun phrases. Per carve-out for lectures, this format is correct. This is teaching consolidation, not action-directing exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No inline links present in body prose. No cross-references using filenames. Lecture is self-contained narrative, not linking to other files.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ordinals stop using numbers for positions.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No ordinals (Step 4, Phase 3, the third bullet). References use names ("the three-pattern", "the verifier") not positions. Module references use M1-M8 convention (names, not positions).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Disambiguate shared-word collisions with Claude Code primitives on first student-authored use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "Memory" mentioned (line 185) in context of training state, clearly distinguished from Claude Code auto-memory by context. No collision confusion. Compliant.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: LLM-vs-agent-vs-Claude vocabulary discipline.
rules_evaluated.evidence: "Agent" used for autonomous work ("agent finds", "session taught"). "Claude" used for invocation/product references. "LLM" for reasoning ("non-deterministic agent"). Vocabulary discipline maintained throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Zero time-of-day anchors (tomorrow, overnight, this morning, etc.). References use module names (M4, M5, M6) and session-relative language. Compliant.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No labeled reflection beats or contemplative-pause prefixes. Closing bullets lead directly to action and principle without announcing reflection. Invisible integration achieved.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture close (teaching content), not an exercise with prompts. No meta-asks present; no prior-prompt decision loops. Rule applies to exercise format, not lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture close (teaching prose), not an artifact-creation context. No save-as-file instructions present. Rule applies to prompt design, not lecture content.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every sentence moves student forward in understanding. No implementation details before use, no accurate-but-not-moving asides, no administrative information leaked into body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body "read it" / "look at it" / "notice X" after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No generic "read it" / "look at it" commands after diagrams. Diagrams provide visual, then prose moves to next action/principle. No narration of what student already sees.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 200 kicker: "The next dashed loop is yours to draw solid." Student is grammatical subject. No training-as-subject, no coach-register imperative, no audience-shift. Compliant.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture close, not an operational instruction context. No operational settings mentioned. Rule applies to exercise and module setup, not lecture.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Vocabulary draws from training's earned concepts: the loop, the map, gates and checks, drift, send-off and return. No invented synonyms. Language re-encodes the model throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No "typing", "saying", "tell it to" phrasing. Language refers to prompts and moves as nouns. Student action stays agency-flat, not narrated as operator work. Compliant.
